items.title: Natively a LITERAL leg of a `match` whose subject is a call handing back `Option<&str>` emits Rust rustc refuses — `match shelf.at(0) { Some("first") => .., Some(let name) => *name, None => .. }` fails E0277 (`PartialEq<str>` is not implemented for `Rc<str>`, at `&*__literal0 == "first"`); JS prints `lit` since B577
items.body: F21 carries the payload view through a `match` subject as a reference, and the literal test compares the reference's `&Rc<str>` against `&str`. The JS side (B577, fix-51) tests a literal leg against the value read out of the kept subject while the capturing leg keeps the view. Natively the literal comparison needs one more deref (`**__literal0 == *"first"`, rustc's own suggestion) when the subject carries a payload view. Expected on both: `lit`, `second`, `none`, `only literal`. Sizing S; vilan-rust's pattern emission. native-51's.

items.title: The `[derive(Wire)]` / `[derive(Hashable)]` field check renders a `dyn` field's type as `_` — "field `source` of `[derive(Wire)]` type `Holder` is `_`, which is not Wire" — and since G25 it follows the derive's own refusal as a second diagnostic about the same field
items.body: The analyzer's derive field check (ledger rows 2 and 3) prints the field's resolved type, and a `Dyn` type renders as `_` there. G25 (fix-51) refuses `[derive(Wire)]`/`[derive(Json)]` over a `dyn` member above the generators, naming the member and its written type; the check still runs afterwards and reports the same field again. Fix: render `dyn Trait<..>` in the check (the type printer's `Dyn` arm), and skip the field check for a derive the expansion already refused (or let the refusal stand alone, B161's one-report rule). Sizing S; analyzer.rs.

items.title: `[derive(Storable)]` in a program that never imports `std::reactive::store` read "expanded before std's `reactive/store.vl` declared its `Storable` macro: a compiler load-ordering bug (B21's class); please report how this module is reached" — a missing import blamed on the compiler
items.body: The B21 sentence assumes every std derive's module loads with every program; that holds for compare/default/debug/json/hash (the analyzer's always-loaded set) and not for `reactive/store.vl` (A142 S7's Storable), which loads only by an import. Fixed in fix-51: `IMPORTED_STD_DERIVES` names the derives whose module an import loads, and the refusal writes the import line (`import std::reactive::store::Storable;`). Pin: `a_storable_derive_without_its_import_steers_to_the_import`. Ledger row NEW.

items.title: A `macro fun` in an inline `mod { }` is in scope in that `mod` (G27) and reachable from nowhere else — `import tables::tabled;` reads "cannot find module 'tables' to import", and `[tables::tabled]` is no attribute form — so `export macro fun` inside an inline mod exports nothing
items.body: G27 (fix-51) registers a mod's macros under the mod-qualified name and resolves them from the innermost enclosing mod out; a sibling mod and the file's top level do not see them (pinned). Macro imports resolve only `std::`/`pkg::`/dependency module paths by leaf (`macros::scope_for`), and an inline mod is not a module path there. Decide: (a) an inline mod's exported macros are importable (`import self::tables::tabled` or whatever reaches an inline mod's member) and `scope_for` learns the path; (b) refuse `export` on a `macro fun` inside an inline mod with a steer; (c) leave it. Rec (b) now, (a) when inline-mod imports are specified. Sizing S.

items.title: vilan-rust's `type_of` looks a CALL up in `inferred_return_types` by the call's id, but that table is keyed by FUNCTION id — the lookup can never hit, and the arm silently falls through to `declared_return_type`
items.body: `Expr::Call(call_id) => self.program.inferred_return_types.get(call_id)..` (the table's doc: "keyed by function alone"). Harmless today because `declared_return_type` → `signature_return_type` → `return_type_of(function)` reads the inferred return for an unannotated callee, but the first hop reads as if call-keyed answers existed. Fix: drop the hop (or key it by the call's target). Found reading the native backend while B578 (fix-51) taught the JS emitter a call's result type. Sizing XS; native-51's.
